Package index

Package overview

What qesR does, its options and its conditions, in English and in French (?qesR-fr), with a table of every function.

qesR qesR-package
qesR: Access Quebec Election Study Datasets
qesR-fr
qesR en français

Data

Load a study from its pinned original file, or build the legacy merged file of qesR 0.4.4. Data are returned, never written into your workspace unless you ask.

get_qes()
Download and Load a Quebec Election Study
get_qes_master()
Build the Legacy Stacked Master QES Dataset

Studies and documents

The offline catalog of the studies qesR can load, their codebooks, questionnaires and reports, and the original files themselves. No network request unless you ask for one.

qes_studies()
List the studies qesR can load
qes_docs()
List the documents of each study
qes_download()
Download the original files of a study

Codebooks and search

What each variable measures, the exact question asked, in English and French, and which codes mean “don’t know” or “refused”. Offline for every study (the metadata of the 2022 study keeps its licence, CC BY-NC 4.0).

qes_codebook()
The codebook of a study
qes_question()
The exact wording of survey questions
qes_search()
Search variables across studies, in English and French
qes_missing()
Set "don't know", "refused" and other missing codes to NA

Harmonization (experimental)

One data frame across the 11 studies, from a specification checked against the original files (rows signed off by a reviewer are applied by default, the rows still in review only with include_draft = TRUE): qes_spec() shows which studies have which harmonized variable and how comparable each study’s question is; qes_harmonize() applies it, with a reason for every missing value and each respondent’s waves and weights; qes_design() turns the result into a survey design. Articles, in English and French: Harmonizing across studies, from qes_harmonize() to a weighted estimate; Coverage by study, the grade of every target in every study; Validation against official results, the harmonized studies against the official results and the census; and the Harmonization reference.

qes_spec()
The harmonization spec (experimental)
qes_harmonize()
Harmonize variables across studies (experimental)
qes_design()
Harmonized data as a survey design (experimental)
qes_party_lineage()
Join the parties of one lineage (ADQ and CAQ) in harmonized data

Reproducibility

Which file a result was read from, and how to cite qesR and each dataset.

qes_provenance()
Where a study's data came from
qes_cite()
Cite qesR and the studies it loads

Cache

Where downloaded files are kept, and how to list or delete them.

qes_cache_info()
List the files in the download cache
qes_cache_clear()
Delete files from the download cache

Legacy and deprecated

Functions from qesR 0.4.4. They keep working, with the same arguments, and will not be removed; each prints a one-time notice naming its replacement. Moving from qesR 0.4.4 to 0.7.0 says what changed in their results.

0.4.4 Replacement
get_codebook(), get_qes_codebook() qes_codebook()
format_codebook() qes_codebook(codebook, layout = )
get_value_labels() qes_codebook(layout = "long")
get_question() qes_question()
get_codebook_files(), get_qes_codebook_files() qes_docs()
download_codebook() qes_download(what = "docs")
get_preview() head(get_qes())
get_qescodes() qes_studies()
get_decon() qes_harmonize(srvy, targets = "decon")

get_question()
